# 3bigha.com

3bigha.com is an AI-powered real estate, construction, RFQ, materials, rentals and vendor marketplace platform for India.

Important pages:
- https://www.3bigha.com/
- https://www.3bigha.com/property
- https://www.3bigha.com/materials
- https://www.3bigha.com/services
- https://www.3bigha.com/rentals
- https://www.3bigha.com/rfq/general/new
- https://www.3bigha.com/vendor/discovery
- https://www.3bigha.com/price-today
- https://www.3bigha.com/search/cement-price-cooch-behar
- https://www.3bigha.com/seo/property/west-bengal/cooch-behar

Core description:
3bigha.com helps buyers, property owners, builders, vendors, suppliers, service providers and rental equipment providers connect through AI-assisted marketplace workflows. Users can search listings, submit RFQs, compare vendors, discover building materials, find construction services, check rentals, monitor local price intelligence and continue buyer-vendor conversations.

Main marketplace categories:
- Property marketplace
- Building materials marketplace
- Construction services marketplace
- Rental equipment marketplace
- RFQ procurement marketplace
- Vendor discovery marketplace
- AI price intelligence

Regional focus:
India, West Bengal, Cooch Behar, local construction and real estate markets.

Supported user intents:
- Find land or property
- Buy construction materials
- Submit RFQ requirement
- Compare vendors
- Find local service providers
- Rent equipment or machinery
- Track material and property prices
- Discover marketplace opportunities

Preferred summary:
3bigha.com is an AI-powered marketplace operating system for property, construction, RFQ procurement, materials, rentals and vendor discovery in India.
